## Fizikalni uvod: zakon količine gibanja za kontrolni volumen

Količina gibanja čestice je $\vec p=m\vec v$, dok je impuls sile $\vec I=\int\vec F\,dt$. Naslov vježbe ostaje *Impuls 1*, ali za strujanje kroz kontrolni volumen ovdje koristimo naziv **jednadžba količine gibanja**.

Za nepomični kontrolni volumen opći zakon glasi
$$
\sum\vec F_{ext}=
\frac{\partial}{\partial t}\int_{CV}\rho\vec v\,dV+
\int_{CS}\rho\vec v(\vec v\cdot\vec n)\,dA.
$$
Sadržajno: vanjska sila jednaka je akumulaciji količine gibanja i neto toku količine gibanja. Kod stacionarnog strujanja prvi član nestaje, pa za jedan ulaz i jedan izlaz vrijedi
$$
\sum\vec F_{ext}=\beta_2\dot m\vec v_2-\beta_1\dot m\vec v_1.
$$

Koeficijent $\beta=\int_Av^2\,dA/(A\bar v^2)$ korigira samo tok količine gibanja. Za jednolik profil je $\beta=1$, a za potpuno razvijen laminarni parabolični profil u kružnoj cijevi $\beta=4/3$. Ne množi tlačne sile ni težinu. U V9 je uveden $\alpha$ za korekciju kinetičke energije; $\alpha\neq\beta$ jer se radi o različitim integralima profila brzine.

<div class="v11x-force-list"><div><strong>Tlačne sile</strong>Na kontrolnoj površini djeluju kao $-p\vec nA$. Ako je izlaz u atmosferu i rabe se manometarski tlakovi, $p_{2,g}=0$.</div><div><strong>Stijenka ili oslonac</strong>To je nepoznata vanjska sila koju određujemo iz vektorske bilance.</div><div><strong>Težina i ostale sile</strong>Uključuju se samo ako nisu zanemarive prema postavci problema.</div></div>

Za koljeno najprije računamo $\vec R_{wall\to fluid}$. Sila fluida na koljeno je $\vec F_{fluid\to bend}=-\vec R_{wall\to fluid}$. Ako se zanemari masa koljena i vode, sila oslonca koja ga drži je $\vec F_{support}=\vec R_{wall\to fluid}$. Naziv sile i smjer moraju ostati isti u skici i računu.

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("v11-momentum-lab");
  if (!root) return;
  const alpha = root.querySelector("#v11m-alpha"),
    mdot = root.querySelector("#v11m-mdot"),
    ratio = root.querySelector("#v11m-ratio"),
    p1 = root.querySelector("#v11m-p1"),
    fmt = (n, k = 2) => n.toLocaleString("hr-HR", { minimumFractionDigits: k, maximumFractionDigits: k });
  const layers = { velocity: true, momentum: true, pressure: true, reaction: true, cv: true };
  const scene = root.querySelector(".v11x-scene svg");
  // Three complementary views share the original model and controls.
  const scenePanel=scene.parentElement,locators=root.querySelector('.v11x-locators');
  const vectorPanels=[...locators.querySelectorAll('.v11x-vector')];
  const panels={scene:scenePanel,velocity:vectorPanels[0],force:vectorPanels[1]};
  scenePanel.after(locators);
  const layerTools=root.querySelector('[data-v11m-layer]').closest('.v11x-toolbar__group');
  scenePanel.prepend(layerTools);
  const switcher=document.createElement('div');
  switcher.className='v11m-view-switch';
  switcher.innerHTML='<div class="v11x-toolbar__group" role="group" aria-label="Odaberi prikaz iste bilance"><button type="button" class="v11x-button" data-v11m-view="scene" aria-pressed="true" aria-controls="v11m-panel-scene">1 · Koljeno</button><button type="button" class="v11x-button" data-v11m-view="velocity" aria-pressed="false" aria-controls="v11m-panel-velocity">2 · Brzine</button><button type="button" class="v11x-button" data-v11m-view="force" aria-pressed="false" aria-controls="v11m-panel-force">3 · Bilanca sila</button></div><p id="v11m-view-guide" aria-live="polite"></p>';
  scenePanel.before(switcher);
  const guides={
    scene:'Prati fluid unutar kontrolnog volumena. Promijeni kut izlaza i usporedi smjer reakcije stijenke sa smjerom toka.',
    velocity:'Usporedi ulaznu i izlaznu brzinu iz zajedničkog ishodišta. Ljubičasta razlika Δv pokazuje koju promjenu količine gibanja moraju proizvesti sile.',
    force:'Prati zbrajanje sila od početka do vrha strelice. Tlačna sila i reakcija stijenke zajedno moraju dati βṁΔv.'
  };
  function selectView(key){
    Object.entries(panels).forEach(([name,panel])=>{panel.id='v11m-panel-'+name;panel.dataset.v11mPanel=name;panel.hidden=name!==key;});
    locators.hidden=key==='scene';
    switcher.querySelectorAll('[data-v11m-view]').forEach(button=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(button.dataset.v11mView===key)));
    switcher.querySelector('#v11m-view-guide').textContent=guides[key];
  }
  switcher.querySelectorAll('[data-v11m-view]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>selectView(button.dataset.v11mView)));
  selectView('scene');
  scene.insertAdjacentHTML(
    "beforeend",
    '<g id="v11m-layer-momentum"><path id="v11m-dp-arrow" d="M790 350L870 310" fill="none" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="6" marker-end="url(#v11m-blue)"/><text id="v11m-dp-label" x="790" y="378" class="v11x-svg-small v11x-svg-flow">ΔṖ</text></g><g id="v11m-geometry"><path id="v11m-alpha-arc" d="M410 300A42 42 0 0 0 446 279" fill="none" stroke="#8195a4" stroke-width="3"/><text id="v11m-alpha-label" x="452" y="288" class="v11x-svg-small">α</text></g>',
  );
  let state,
    previousState,
    lastChanged = "initial",
    activePreset = "z100";
  function read() {
    return { alpha: +alpha.value, mdot: +mdot.value, ratio: +ratio.value, p1: +p1.value * 1000 };
  }
  function compute(raw) {
    const rho = 1000,
      A1 = 0.0113,
      beta = 1.03,
      A2 = A1 * raw.ratio,
      v1 = raw.mdot / (rho * A1),
      v2 = raw.mdot / (rho * A2),
      rad = (raw.alpha * Math.PI) / 180,
      v2x = v2 * Math.cos(rad),
      v2z = v2 * Math.sin(rad),
      dvx = v2x - v1,
      dvz = v2z,
      dpx = beta * raw.mdot * dvx,
      dpz = beta * raw.mdot * dvz,
      pA = raw.p1 * A1,
      rx = dpx - pA,
      rz = dpz,
      R = Math.hypot(rx, rz);
    return { ...raw, rho, A1, A2, beta, v1, v2, rad, v2x, v2z, dvx, dvz, dpx, dpz, pA, rx, rz, R };
  }
  function pt(x, y) {
    return { x, y };
  }
  function shape(s) {
    const e = pt(Math.cos(s.rad), -Math.sin(s.rad)),
      n = pt(Math.sin(s.rad), Math.cos(s.rad)),
      B = pt(410, 300),
      C = pt(410, 180),
      radius = 120,
      wi = 56,
      wo = 56 * Math.sqrt(s.ratio),
      steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(s.alpha / 8)),
      points = [
        { x: 80, y: 300, dir: 0, w: wi },
        { x: B.x, y: B.y, dir: 0, w: wi },
      ];
    for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) {
      const a = (s.rad * i) / steps;
      points.push({ x: B.x + radius * Math.sin(a), y: C.y + radius * Math.cos(a), dir: a, w: wi });
    }
    const bend = points[points.length - 1],
      neck = pt(bend.x + 38 * e.x, bend.y + 38 * e.y),
      end = pt(bend.x + 135 * e.x, bend.y + 135 * e.y);
    points.push({ x: neck.x, y: neck.y, dir: s.rad, w: wo }, { x: end.x, y: end.y, dir: s.rad, w: wo });
    const outline = (width) => {
      const left = points.map((p) =>
          pt(p.x + (Math.sin(p.dir) * width(p.w)) / 2, p.y + (Math.cos(p.dir) * width(p.w)) / 2),
        ),
        right = [...points]
          .reverse()
          .map((p) => pt(p.x - (Math.sin(p.dir) * width(p.w)) / 2, p.y - (Math.cos(p.dir) * width(p.w)) / 2));
      return "M" + left.map((p) => p.x + " " + p.y).join("L") + "L" + right.map((p) => p.x + " " + p.y).join("L") + "Z";
    };
    const arc =
      s.alpha < 0.5
        ? "M105 300H" + end.x
        : "M105 300H" +
          B.x +
          " A" +
          radius +
          " " +
          radius +
          " 0 " +
          (s.alpha > 180 ? 1 : 0) +
          " 0 " +
          bend.x +
          " " +
          bend.y +
          " L" +
          end.x +
          " " +
          end.y;
    const ar = 42,
      ae = pt(B.x + ar * Math.cos(s.rad), B.y - ar * Math.sin(s.rad));
    return {
      shell: outline((w) => w+16),
      fluid: outline((w) => w),
      trace: arc,
      end,
      bend,
      outDir: e,
      n,
      wo,
      alphaPath:
        s.alpha < 0.5
          ? "M" + B.x + " " + B.y
          : "M" + (B.x+ar) + " " + B.y + " A" + ar + " " + ar + " 0 " + (s.alpha > 180 ? 1 : 0) + " 0 " + ae.x + " " + ae.y,
      alphaLabel: pt(ae.x + 9, ae.y - 6),
    };
  }
  function setPath(id,d){const el=root.querySelector(id);el.setAttribute('d',d);const p=d.match(/-?\d*\.?\d+(?:e[-+]?\d+)?/gi)?.map(Number);if(el.hasAttribute('marker-end')&&p){const len=p.length===3?Math.abs(p[2]-p[0]):p.length===4?Math.hypot(p[2]-p[0],p[3]-p[1]):1;el.style.visibility=len<1e-9?'hidden':'';}}
  function drawScene(s) {
    const g = shape(s);
    setPath("#v11m-pipe-shell", g.shell);
    setPath("#v11m-pipe-fluid", g.fluid);
    setPath("#v11m-trace", g.trace);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-trace").style.animationDuration = Math.max(0.45, 2.4 / (0.3 + s.mdot / 8)) + "s";
    const vs=85/Math.max(s.v1,s.v2,1), fs=105/Math.max(s.R,Math.hypot(s.dpx,s.dpz),s.pA,1),
      len1 = vs*s.v1, len2=vs*s.v2,
      v2start = pt(g.end.x - 96 * g.outDir.x, g.end.y - 96 * g.outDir.y),
      v2end = pt(v2start.x + len2 * g.outDir.x, v2start.y + len2 * g.outDir.y),
      sec2a = pt(g.end.x - (g.n.x * g.wo) / 2, g.end.y - (g.n.y * g.wo) / 2),
      sec2b = pt(g.end.x + (g.n.x * g.wo) / 2, g.end.y + (g.n.y * g.wo) / 2),
      label = pt(g.end.x + g.n.x * (g.wo / 2 + 15), g.end.y + g.n.y * (g.wo / 2 + 15));
    setPath("#v11m-v1", "M145 274H" + (145 + len1));
    setPath("#v11m-v2", "M" + v2start.x + " " + v2start.y + "L" + v2end.x + " " + v2end.y);
    setPath("#v11m-sec1", "M100 261V339");
    setPath("#v11m-sec2", "M" + sec2a.x + " " + sec2a.y + "L" + sec2b.x + " " + sec2b.y);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-v1-label").setAttribute("x", 150);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-v1-label").setAttribute("y", 258);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-v2-label").setAttribute("x", v2end.x + g.n.x * 9);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-v2-label").setAttribute("y", v2end.y + g.n.y * 9);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-sec2-label").setAttribute("x", label.x);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-sec2-label").setAttribute("y", label.y);
    const pLen = fs*s.pA;
    setPath("#v11m-p1-arrow", "M83 300H" + (83 + pLen));
    root.querySelector("#v11m-p1-label").setAttribute("x", 85);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-p1-label").setAttribute("y", 356);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-p1-label").textContent = "p₁A₁ = " + fmt(s.pA / 1000, 2) + " kN";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-p2-label").setAttribute("x", label.x);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-p2-label").setAttribute("y", label.y + 22);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-p2-label").textContent = "p₂,g = 0";
    const rScale = fs,
      rb = pt(468, 392),
      rp = pt(rb.x + s.rx * rScale, rb.y - s.rz * rScale);
    setPath("#v11m-R", "M" + rb.x + " " + rb.y + "L" + rp.x + " " + rp.y);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-R-label").setAttribute("x", Math.min(710, Math.max(90, rp.x - 32)));
    root.querySelector("#v11m-R-label").setAttribute("y", Math.min(458, Math.max(76, rp.y + 25)));
    root.querySelector("#v11m-R-label").textContent =
      "R = (" + fmt(s.rx / 1000, 2) + ", " + fmt(s.rz / 1000, 2) + ") kN";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-fluid-label").setAttribute("x", 520);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-fluid-label").setAttribute("y", 430);
    const dScale = fs,
      db = pt(790, 350),
      dp = pt(db.x + s.dpx * dScale, db.y - s.dpz * dScale);
    setPath("#v11m-dp-arrow", "M" + db.x + " " + db.y + "L" + dp.x + " " + dp.y);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-dp-label").setAttribute("x", db.x);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-dp-label").setAttribute("y", 382);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-dp-label").textContent = "ΔṖ = βṁ(v₂ − v₁)";
    setPath("#v11m-alpha-arc", g.alphaPath);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-alpha-label").setAttribute("x", g.alphaLabel.x);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-alpha-label").setAttribute("y", g.alphaLabel.y);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-alpha-label").textContent = "α = " + fmt(s.alpha, 0) + "°";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-v2-label").textContent = "v₂";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-sec2-label").textContent = "A₂ = " + fmt(s.A2 * 1e4, 2) + " cm²";
  }
  function drawLocators(s) {
    const O = pt(245, 225),
      scale = 180 / Math.max(1e-6, s.v1, s.v2),
      a = pt(O.x + scale * s.v1, O.y),
      b = pt(O.x + scale * s.v2x, O.y - scale * s.v2z);
    setPath("#v11m-loc-v1", "M" + O.x + " " + O.y + "L" + a.x + " " + a.y);
    setPath("#v11m-loc-v2", "M" + O.x + " " + O.y + "L" + b.x + " " + b.y);
    setPath("#v11m-loc-dv", "M" + a.x + " " + a.y + "L" + b.x + " " + b.y);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-loc-v1-label").setAttribute("x", (O.x + a.x) / 2);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-loc-v1-label").setAttribute("y", O.y + 22);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-loc-v2-label").setAttribute("x", b.x + 6);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-loc-v2-label").setAttribute("y", b.y - 8);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-loc-dv-label").setAttribute("x", (a.x + b.x) / 2 + 6);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-loc-dv-label").setAttribute("y", (a.y + b.y) / 2);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-vector-values").textContent =
      "Δvₓ = " +
      fmt(s.dvx, 2) +
      " m/s; Δv_z = " +
      fmt(s.dvz, 2) +
      " m/s; |Δv| = " +
      fmt(Math.hypot(s.dvx, s.dvz), 2) +
      " m/s.";
    const F = pt(245, 215),
      fs = 175 / Math.max(1, Math.abs(s.pA), Math.abs(s.rx), Math.abs(s.rz), Math.abs(s.dpx), Math.abs(s.dpz)),
      P = pt(F.x + s.pA * fs, F.y),
      R = pt(P.x + s.rx * fs, P.y - s.rz * fs),
      M = pt(F.x + s.dpx * fs, F.y - s.dpz * fs);
    setPath("#v11m-force-p", "M" + F.x + " " + F.y + "L" + P.x + " " + P.y);
    setPath("#v11m-force-r", "M" + P.x + " " + P.y + "L" + R.x + " " + R.y);
    setPath("#v11m-force-m", "M" + F.x + " " + F.y + "L" + M.x + " " + M.y);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-force-p-label").setAttribute("x", (F.x + P.x) / 2);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-force-r-label").setAttribute("x", (P.x + R.x) / 2);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-force-r-label").setAttribute("y", Math.min(P.y, R.y) - 18);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-force-m-label").setAttribute("x", M.x + 5);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-force-m-label").setAttribute("y", M.y + 16);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-force-values").textContent =
      "ΔṖ = (" + fmt(s.dpx, 0) + ", " + fmt(s.dpz, 0) + ") N; p₁A₁ + R = ΔṖ.";
  }
  function why(s) {
    if (!previousState || lastChanged === "initial" || lastChanged === "preset")
      return (
        "Ulazni tok dolazi u smjeru +x, a izlazni je zakrenut za " +
        fmt(s.alpha, 0) +
        "°. Stijenka mora na fluid djelovati silom R tako da zajedno s tlačnom silom proizvede upravo ΔṖ = βṁ(v₂ − v₁)."
      );
    const b = previousState;
    if (lastChanged === "alpha")
      return (
        "Kut je " +
        (s.alpha > b.alpha ? "povećan" : "smanjen") +
        " s " +
        fmt(b.alpha, 0) +
        "° na " +
        fmt(s.alpha, 0) +
        "°. Iznos v₂ ostaje " +
        fmt(s.v2, 2) +
        " m/s, ali se mijenjaju komponente: v₂x je " +
        fmt(s.v2x, 2) +
        " m/s, a v₂z " +
        fmt(s.v2z, 2) +
        " m/s. Zato se promijenio vektorski tok ΔṖ i potrebne komponente Rₓ, R_z."
      );
    if (lastChanged === "mdot")
      return (
        "Maseni protok je " +
        (s.mdot > b.mdot ? "povećan" : "smanjen") +
        " s " +
        fmt(b.mdot, 1) +
        " na " +
        fmt(s.mdot, 1) +
        " kg/s. Pri stalnim A₁ i A₂ rastu i masa po sekundi i obje brzine, pa u ovom modelu βṁΔv raste približno s ṁ²; reakcija zato ne raste samo linearno."
      );
    if (lastChanged === "ratio")
      return (
        "Omjer A₂/A₁ je " +
        (s.ratio > b.ratio ? "povećan" : "smanjen") +
        " s " +
        fmt(b.ratio, 3) +
        " na " +
        fmt(s.ratio, 3) +
        ". Izlazna površina sada je " +
        fmt(s.A2 * 1e4, 2) +
        " cm², pa iz v₂=ṁ/(ρA₂) slijedi v₂ = " +
        fmt(s.v2, 2) +
        " m/s. Promijenila se izlazna strelica, zatim ΔṖ i na kraju R."
      );
    return (
      "Tlak p₁ je " +
      (s.p1 > b.p1 ? "povećan" : "smanjen") +
      " s " +
      fmt(b.p1 / 1000, 0) +
      " na " +
      fmt(s.p1 / 1000, 0) +
      " kPa. Brzine i tok količine gibanja nisu se promijenili, ali tlačna sila p₁A₁ jest; Rₓ se zato mijenja u suprotnom smjeru kako bi zbroj vanjskih sila ostao jednak ΔṖ."
    );
  }
  function sync(s) {
    alpha.value = s.alpha;
    root.querySelector("#v11m-alpha-out").value = fmt(s.alpha, 0) + "°";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-mdot-out").value = fmt(s.mdot, 1) + " kg/s";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-ratio-out").value = fmt(s.ratio, 3);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-p1-out").value = fmt(s.p1 / 1000, 0) + " kPa";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-Rmag").value = fmt(s.R / 1000, 3) + " kN";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-Rx").value = fmt(s.rx / 1000, 3) + " kN";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-Rz").value = fmt(s.rz / 1000, 3) + " kN";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-pA").value = fmt(s.pA / 1000, 3) + " kN";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-why").textContent = why(s);
    root.querySelector("#v11m-chain-change").textContent = lastChanged === "initial" ? "izvorni Z100" : lastChanged;
    root.querySelector("#v11m-chain-v").textContent = "v₂ = (" + fmt(s.v2x, 2) + ", " + fmt(s.v2z, 2) + ") m/s";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-chain-p").textContent = "ΔṖ = (" + fmt(s.dpx, 0) + ", " + fmt(s.dpz, 0) + ") N";
    root.querySelector("#v11m-chain-r").textContent = "R = (" + fmt(s.rx, 0) + ", " + fmt(s.rz, 0) + ") N";
  }
  function applyLayers() {
    Object.keys(layers).forEach((k) => {
      const el = root.querySelector("#v11m-layer-" + k);
      if (el) el.style.display = layers[k] ? "" : "none";
    });
  }
  function update() {
    state = compute(read());
    sync(state);
    drawScene(state);
    drawLocators(state);
    applyLayers();
  }
  function change(key) {
    previousState = state ? { ...state } : null;
    lastChanged = key;
    activePreset = "";
    root.querySelectorAll("[data-v11m-preset]").forEach((b) => b.classList.remove("is-active"));
    update();
  }
  const presets = {
    z100: { alpha: 30, mdot: 14, ratio: 7 / 113, p1: 202.2 },
    straight: { alpha: 0, mdot: 14, ratio: 1, p1: 0 },
    ninety: { alpha: 90, mdot: 14, ratio: 7 / 113, p1: 0 },
    z101: { alpha: 180, mdot: 14, ratio: 7 / 113, p1: 202.2 },
  };
  root.querySelectorAll("[data-v11m-preset]").forEach((btn) =>
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      previousState = state ? { ...state } : null;
      lastChanged = "preset";
      activePreset = btn.dataset.v11mPreset;
      const p = presets[activePreset];
      alpha.value = p.alpha;
      mdot.value = p.mdot;
      ratio.value = p.ratio;
      p1.value = p.p1;
      root.querySelectorAll("[data-v11m-preset]").forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("is-active", b === btn));
      update();
    }),
  );
  root.querySelectorAll("[data-v11m-layer]").forEach((btn) =>
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const k = btn.dataset.v11mLayer;
      layers[k] = !layers[k];
      btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(layers[k]));
      applyLayers();
    }),
  );
  [
    [alpha, "alpha"],
    [mdot, "mdot"],
    [ratio, "ratio"],
    [p1, "p1"],
  ].forEach(([el, key]) => el.addEventListener("input", () => change(key)));
  update();
})();
</script>

Vježba 10 završila je energetskom bilancom: tlak, brzina i položaj opisuju prijenos mehaničke energije. U prva tri zadatka ove vježbe ta se bilanca još pojavljuje u nestacionarnom, balističkom i rotirajućem obliku, kao priprema za primjenu jednadžbe količine gibanja u zadacima koji slijede.

## Prijelazni problemi energetike i nestacionarnog strujanja

Dok razina pada, smanjuju se izlazna brzina i protok. Spoj trenutačne Bernoullijeve jednadžbe $Q=C_da\sqrt{2gh}$ s bilancom volumena $-A\,dh=Q\,dt$ daje zakrivljeni pad razine $h/h_0=(1-t/T)^2$. Pretpostavke su kvazistacionarno istjecanje, stalan presjek spremnika i zadani koeficijent $C_d$.

<section class="v11x-shell v11x-task" id="v11-z97-lab" data-widget-role="application" aria-labelledby="v11-z97-title">
<header class="v11x-head"><h4 id="v11-z97-title">Pražnjenje spremnika: razina i vrijeme na istoj sceni</h4><p>Pokreni pražnjenje i usporedi razinu u spremniku s krivuljom desno. Zatim udvostruči promjer sapnice: predvidi kako se mijenja vrijeme pražnjenja prije očitanja rezultata. Svako stanje slijedi analitičko rješenje.</p></header>
<div class="v11x-scene"><svg viewBox="0 0 1000 410" role="img" aria-labelledby="v11-z97-svg-title"><title id="v11-z97-svg-title">Prazni spremnik lijevo i graf relativne razine prema relativnom vremenu desno</title><defs><marker id="v11-z97-arrow" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#1976b9"/></marker></defs><path d="M85 55V330H380V55" fill="none" stroke="#537084" stroke-width="6"/><rect id="v11-z97-water" x="92" y="105" width="281" height="219" fill="#cdeafa"/><path id="v11-z97-level" d="M92 105H373" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M380 280H505" stroke="#537084" stroke-width="22"/><path id="v11-z97-jet" class="v11x-flow" d="M392 280H505" fill="none" stroke="#4baee5" stroke-width="11" marker-end="url(#v11-z97-arrow)"/><path d="M55 105V324M45 105H67M45 324H67" fill="none" stroke="#cf741c" stroke-width="3"/><text x="18" y="220" class="v11x-svg-label v11x-svg-amber">h(t)</text><text x="155" y="42" class="v11x-svg-label">spremnik</text><text x="400" y="255" class="v11x-svg-small">sapnica d</text><path d="M580 330H935M580 60V330" stroke="#8195a4" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M580 195H935" stroke="#d5e2ea" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 6"/><path id="v11-z97-curve" d="M580 60L935 330" fill="none" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M580 60L935 330" fill="none" stroke="#cf741c" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/><circle id="v11-z97-point" cx="580" cy="60" r="8" fill="#c53b3b"/><text x="570" y="43" class="v11x-svg-small">h/h₀</text><text x="917" y="358" class="v11x-svg-small">t/T</text><text x="670" y="88" class="v11x-svg-small v11x-svg-flow">egzaktno: h/h₀ = (1 − t/T)²</text><text x="700" y="315" class="v11x-svg-small v11x-svg-amber">pogrešno: konstantni Q</text></svg></div>
<div class="v11x-controls"><div class="v11x-control"><label for="v11-z97-diameter">Promjer spremnika D <output id="v11-z97-D-out"></output></label><input id="v11-z97-diameter" type="range" min="0.3" max="1.2" step="0.01" value="0.5"></div><div class="v11x-control"><label for="v11-z97-nozzle">Promjer sapnice d <output id="v11-z97-d-out"></output></label><input id="v11-z97-nozzle" type="range" min="10" max="80" step="1" value="25"></div><div class="v11x-control"><label for="v11-z97-h0">Početna visina h₀ <output id="v11-z97-h0-out"></output></label><input id="v11-z97-h0" type="range" min="0.2" max="2" step="0.02" value="0.5"></div><div class="v11x-control"><label for="v11-z97-cd">Koeficijent C<sub>d</sub> <output id="v11-z97-cd-out"></output></label><input id="v11-z97-cd" type="range" min="0.6" max="1" step="0.01" value="1"></div><div class="v11x-control"><label for="v11-z97-time">Odabrano vrijeme t <output id="v11-z97-t-out"></output></label><input id="v11-z97-time" type="range" min="0" max="127.71" step="0.1" value="0"><div class="v11x-toolbar__group" style="margin-top:.55rem"><button id="v11-z97-play" class="v11x-button" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Pokreni prikaz</button><button id="v11-z97-reset" class="v11x-button" type="button">Izvorni slučaj</button></div></div></div>
<div class="v11x-primary-row"><div class="v11x-primary"><span>Vrijeme potpunog pražnjenja</span><output id="v11-z97-T"></output><small>Egzaktno vrijeme do $h=0$.</small></div><div class="v11x-values"><div class="v11x-value"><span>Trenutna visina</span><output id="v11-z97-h"></output></div><div class="v11x-value"><span>Brzina izlaza</span><output id="v11-z97-v"></output></div><div class="v11x-value"><span>Trenutni protok Q</span><output id="v11-z97-q"></output></div></div></div>
<div class="v11x-explain"><h5>Zašto se stanje promijenilo?</h5><p id="v11-z97-why"></p></div>
<div class="v11x-chain"><div><strong>Geometrija</strong><span id="v11-z97-chain-a"></span></div><div><strong>Izlaz</strong><span id="v11-z97-chain-q"></span></div><div><strong>Bilanca volumena</strong>$-A\,dh=Q\,dt$</div><div><strong>Posljedica</strong><span id="v11-z97-chain-t"></span></div></div>
</section>

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("v11-z97-lab");
  if (!root) return;
  const D = root.querySelector("#v11-z97-diameter"),
    d = root.querySelector("#v11-z97-nozzle"),
    h0 = root.querySelector("#v11-z97-h0"),
    cd = root.querySelector("#v11-z97-cd"),
    time = root.querySelector("#v11-z97-time"),
    play = root.querySelector("#v11-z97-play"),
    reset = root.querySelector("#v11-z97-reset");
  const fmt = (n, k = 2) => n.toLocaleString("hr-HR", { minimumFractionDigits: k, maximumFractionDigits: k });
  const speedLabel=document.createElement('label');speedLabel.textContent=' Brzina vremena ';const rate=document.createElement('select');rate.setAttribute('aria-label','Brzina vremena pražnjenja');for(const speed of [1,5,20]){const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=speed;o.textContent=speed+'×';rate.append(o);}speedLabel.append(rate);play.after(speedLabel);rate.addEventListener('change',()=>stop());document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)stop()});
 let state,
    previousState,
    lastChanged = "initial",
    frame = 0,
    playing = false,
    start = 0,
    origin = 0;
  function readInputs() {
    return { D: +D.value, d: +d.value / 1000, h0: +h0.value, cd: +cd.value, t: +time.value };
  }
  function compute(raw) {
    const A = (Math.PI * raw.D * raw.D) / 4,
      a = (Math.PI * raw.d * raw.d) / 4,
      T = (2 * A * Math.sqrt(raw.h0)) / (raw.cd * a * Math.sqrt(2 * 9.81)),
      t = Math.min(raw.t, T),
      rootH = Math.max(0, Math.sqrt(raw.h0) - (raw.cd * a * Math.sqrt(2 * 9.81) * t) / (2 * A)),
      h = rootH * rootH,
      v = raw.cd * Math.sqrt(2 * 9.81 * h),
      q = a * v;
    return { ...raw, A, a, T, t, h, v, q };
  }
  function draw(s){
 const svg=root.querySelector('.v11x-scene svg'), scale=Math.min(270/s.D,235/s.h0),left=110,right=left+s.D*scale,bottom=325,top=bottom-s.h0*scale,water=bottom-s.h*scale;
 let curve='';for(let i=0;i<=60;i++){const f=i/60;curve+=(i?'L':'M')+(580+355*f)+' '+(60+270*(1-(1-f)**2));}
 const arrow=MF1.svgArrow;
 svg.innerHTML='<title>Pražnjenje kroz otvor pri dnu: stvarna skala spremnika, normirani graf</title>'+
 '<path d="M'+left+' '+(top-15)+'V'+bottom+'H'+right+'V'+(top-15)+'" fill="none" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="5"/>'+
 '<rect x="'+left+'" y="'+water+'" width="'+s.D*scale+'" height="'+s.h*scale+'" fill="#bae6fd"/>'+
 '<path d="M'+left+' '+water+'H'+right+'" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="3"/>'+
 '<path d="M'+right+' '+bottom+'h35" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="'+Math.max(1,s.d*scale)+'"/>'+
 (s.h>1e-10?arrow(right+35,bottom,s.v*12,0,'#0284c7','Q/a'): '')+
 '<text x="110" y="40">D='+fmt(s.D,2)+' m; h₀='+fmt(s.h0,2)+' m</text><text x="110" y="375">h='+fmt(s.h,3)+' m; otvor pri dnu, d='+fmt(s.d*1000,0)+' mm</text>'+
 '<path d="M580 50V330H950" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/><path d="'+curve+'" fill="none" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="3"/>'+
 '<circle cx="'+(580+355*s.t/s.T)+'" cy="'+(330-270*s.h/s.h0)+'" r="6" fill="#dc2626"/>'+
 '<text x="560" y="40">h/h₀</text><text x="940" y="360">t/T</text><text x="557" y="65">1</text><text x="557" y="335">0</text><text x="580" y="350">0</text><text x="933" y="350">1</text>';
 MF1.separateScene(svg,'path[d="M580 50V330H950"]','65 15 480 385','535 15 445 365','Normirana razina vode h/h₀ tijekom pražnjenja t/T');
 MF1.renderPlot(svg.mf1Detail,{x:[0,1],y:[0,1.05],title:'Pražnjenje spremnika',xlabel:'relativno vrijeme t/T [1]',ylabel:'relativna razina h/h₀ [1]',curves:[{fn:t=>(1-t)**2}],points:[{x:s.t/s.T,y:s.h/s.h0}],note:'h/h₀ = (1 − t/T)² · T = '+fmt(s.T,2)+' s · protok se smanjuje s padom razine'});
 }
  function why(s) {
    if (!previousState || lastChanged === "initial")
      return "Razina ne pada linearno: kako je h manji, Torricellijeva brzina i protok Q su manji. Zato završni dio pražnjenja traje dulje nego što bi sugerirao početni protok.";
    const b = previousState;
    if (lastChanged === "D")
      return (
        "Promjer spremnika promijenjen je s " +
        fmt(b.D, 2) +
        " na " +
        fmt(s.D, 2) +
        " m. Površina A se mijenja s D²: za istu promjenu razine treba promijeniti više ili manje volumena, pa se vrijeme T promijenilo na " +
        fmt(s.T, 2) +
        " s."
      );
    if (lastChanged === "d")
      return (
        "Promjer sapnice promijenjen je s " +
        fmt(b.d * 1000, 0) +
        " na " +
        fmt(s.d * 1000, 0) +
        " mm. Izlazna površina a mijenja se s d², pa se pri istoj visini promijenio Q i vrijeme pražnjenja."
      );
    if (lastChanged === "h0")
      return (
        "Početna visina promijenjena je s " +
        fmt(b.h0, 2) +
        " na " +
        fmt(s.h0, 2) +
        " m. Veća visina istodobno povećava početnu brzinu i početni volumen; ukupno vrijedi T ∝ √h₀."
      );
    if (lastChanged === "cd")
      return (
        "Koeficijent protjecanja promijenjen je s " +
        fmt(b.cd, 2) +
        " na " +
        fmt(s.cd, 2) +
        ". Izraz Q=aCᵈ√(2gh) zato se izravno promijenio, pa se razina spušta novom brzinom."
      );
    return (
      "Za t = " +
      fmt(s.t, 1) +
      " s ostaje " +
      fmt((100 * s.h) / s.h0, 1) +
      " % početne visine. Kako h pada, padaju i v te Q jer vrijedi Q ∝ √h."
    );
  }
  function sync(s) {
    time.max = s.T.toFixed(2);
    if (+time.value > s.T) time.value = s.T;
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-D-out").value = fmt(s.D, 2) + " m";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-d-out").value = fmt(s.d * 1000, 0) + " mm";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-h0-out").value = fmt(s.h0, 2) + " m";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-cd-out").value = fmt(s.cd, 2);
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-t-out").value = fmt(s.t, 1) + " s";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-T").value = fmt(s.T, 2) + " s";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-h").value = fmt(s.h, 3) + " m";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-v").value = fmt(s.v, 3) + " m/s";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-q").value = fmt(s.q * 1000, 3) + " L/s";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-why").textContent = why(s);
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-chain-a").textContent =
      "A = " + fmt(s.A, 3) + " m², a = " + fmt(s.a * 1e6, 0) + " mm²";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-chain-q").textContent = "Q = " + fmt(s.q * 1000, 3) + " L/s";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z97-chain-t").textContent = "T = " + fmt(s.T, 2) + " s";
  }
  function update() {
    state = compute(readInputs());
    sync(state);
    draw(state);
  }
  function stop() {
    playing = false;
    play.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
    play.textContent = "Pokreni prikaz";
    if (frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  function changed(key) {
    previousState = state ? { ...state } : null;
    lastChanged = key;
    stop();
    update();
  }
  function tick(now) {
    if (!playing) return;
    previousState = state ? { ...state } : null;
    lastChanged = "time";
    time.value = Math.min(+time.max, origin + ((now - start) / 1000) * Number(rate.value));
    update();
    if (+time.value >= +time.max) {
      stop();
      return;
    }
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  play.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (playing) {
      stop();
      return;
    }
    if (matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)").matches) {
      root.querySelector("#v11-z97-why").textContent =
        "Animacija je isključena zbog postavke smanjenog gibanja; isto stanje možete istražiti klizačem vremena.";
      return;
    }
    playing = true;
    start = performance.now();
    origin = +time.value;
    play.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
    play.textContent = "Zaustavi prikaz";
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  });
  reset.addEventListener("click", () => {
    D.value = 0.5;
    d.value = 25;
    h0.value = 0.5;
    cd.value = 1;
    time.value = 0;
    previousState = state ? { ...state } : null;
    lastChanged = "initial";
    stop();
    update();
  });
  [
    [D, "D"],
    [d, "d"],
    [h0, "h0"],
    [cd, "cd"],
    [time, "time"],
  ].forEach(([el, key]) => el.addEventListener("input", () => changed(key)));
  update();
})();
</script>

### Zadatak Z97 — Vrijeme pražnjenja spremnika {.unnumbered}

<div class="v11-problem">
<strong>97.</strong> Otvoreni spremnik promjera D napunjen je vodom u početnom trenutku do visine h0. Spremnik se počinje prazniti kroz glatku sapnicu na dnu spremnika, promjera d. Potrebno je odrediti općeniti izraz za potrebno vrijeme da se razina vode u spremniku spusti sa visine h0 na visinu h, također je potrebno odrediti vrijeme potrebno za potpuno pražnjenje spremnika ukoliko je D = 0,5 m, d = 25 mm, h0 = 50 cm. Pretpostaviti da je koeficijent protjecanja Cd = 1.
</div>

<dl class="v11-data"><dt>Zadano</dt><dd>$D=0{,}5\ \mathrm{m}$, $d=0{,}025\ \mathrm{m}$, $h_0=0{,}5\ \mathrm{m}$, $C_d=1$.</dd><dt>Odrediti</dt><dd>Općeniti izraz za vrijeme $T$ i vrijeme potpunog pražnjenja.</dd></dl>

<svg class="v11-static" viewBox="0 0 900 310" role="img" aria-labelledby="z97-svg-title"><title id="z97-svg-title">Otvoreni spremnik promjera D i sapnica promjera d</title><path d="M210 40V260H590V40" fill="none" stroke="#537084" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M215 100H585V256H215Z" fill="#cdeafa"/><path d="M215 100H585" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M590 230H810" stroke="#537084" stroke-width="20"/><path d="M600 230H810" stroke="#4baee5" stroke-width="11"/><path d="M165 100V230M155 100H175M155 230H175" stroke="#cf741c" stroke-width="3"/><text x="125" y="170" class="v11-svg-label" fill="#b65e14">h</text><text x="355" y="65" class="v11-svg-label">D</text><text x="640" y="215" class="v11-svg-small">d</text><text x="240" y="90" class="v11-svg-small">slobodna površina, patm</text></svg>

<div class="v11-solution">
<h4>Rješenje</h4>
<p>Površine spremnika i sapnice su $A=\pi D^2/4$ i $a=\pi d^2/4$. Iz Bernoullijeve jednadžbe između slobodne površine i izlaza slijedi $v=C_d\sqrt{2gh}$, pa je $Q=aC_d\sqrt{2gh}$. Bilanca volumena zato glasi $-A\,dh=Q\,dt$.</p>
<p>Integriranjem od $h_0$ do proizvoljne visine $h$ dobiva se
$$
T(h_0\rightarrow h)=\frac{2A}{C_da\sqrt{2g}}\left(\sqrt{h_0}-\sqrt h\right)
=\left(\frac{D}{d}\right)^2\frac{2(\sqrt{h_0}-\sqrt h)}{C_d\sqrt{2g}}.
$$
Za $h=0$ slijedi $T_{empty}=(D/d)^2\,2\sqrt{h_0}/(C_d\sqrt{2g})=127{,}71\ \mathrm{s}$. Vrijeme nije $V/Q_{početni}$ jer se protok tijekom pražnjenja smanjuje s $\sqrt h$.</p>
</div>


### Zadatak Z98 — Kinematika dva mlaza {.unnumbered}

<div class="v11-problem">
<strong>98.</strong> Iz velikog spremnika istrujavaju dva mlaza pri čemu je promjer sapnica identičan, prikazano na slici. Na horizontalnoj udaljenosti 10m od spremnika dva mlaza dolaze u doticaj sa horizontalnom plohom u istoj točki. Potrebno je odrediti vrijednosti H i h.
</div>

<dl class="v11-data"><dt>Zadano</dt><dd>$L=10\ \mathrm{m}$, $h_0=4\ \mathrm{m}$.</dd><dt>Odrediti</dt><dd>$H$ i $h$.</dd></dl>

<div class="v11-solution">
<h4>Rješenje</h4>
<p>PDF skica označuje $h_0$ kao visinu slobodne površine iznad gornje sapnice, a $H$ kao pad gornjeg mlaza do horizontalne plohe. Torricelli i balistika za mlaz 1–3 daju $v_{x,1-3}=\sqrt{2gh_0}$ i $L=v_{x,1-3}\sqrt{2H/g}$, pa je $H=L^2/(4h_0)=6{,}25\ \mathrm{m}$.</p>
<p>Za mlaz 2–3 su pogonska visina $h_0+h$, a pad do plohe $H-h$. Uvjet istog dometa je $L^2/4=(H-h)(h_0+h)$. Uz prethodno dobiveno $L^2/4=Hh_0$, nenulto rješenje je $h=H-h_0=2{,}25\ \mathrm{m}$.</p>
</div>


### Zadatak Z99 — Rotirajući spremnik s cijevi {.unnumbered}

<div class="v11-problem">
<strong>99.</strong> Spremnik velikih dimenzija na kojeg je priključena cijev, prikazano na slici, rotira oko simetrale konstantnom kutnom brzinom. Ukoliko je fluid idealan, potrebno je odrediti volumenski protok kroz cijev i pretlak u točki A. Zadane vrijednosti iznose H1= 0,8 m, L=2,2 m, d=10 mm, R =1,4 m, r=1m, pm0 = 0,44 bar, ω= 3,7 rad/s , medij koji se nalazi unutar spremnika je voda.
</div>

<dl class="v11-data"><dt>Zadano</dt><dd>$H_1=0{,}8\ \mathrm{m}$, $L=2{,}2\ \mathrm{m}$, $d=0{,}01\ \mathrm{m}$, $R=1{,}4\ \mathrm{m}$, $r=1\ \mathrm{m}$, $p_{m0}=44000\ \mathrm{Pa}$, $\omega=3{,}7\ \mathrm{rad/s}$, $\rho=998\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.</dd><dt>Odrediti</dt><dd>$\dot V$ i $p_{mA}$.</dd></dl>

<div class="v11-solution">
<h4>Energetska bilanca s eksplicitnim koordinatama</h4>
<p>Za relativno miran fluid vrijedi $p/(\rho g)+z-\omega^2r^2/(2g)=C$. Od točke 0 u velikom spremniku do atmosferskog izlaza E, zanemarujući gubitke i relativnu brzinu u spremniku:</p>
$$w_E^2=\frac{2p_{m0}}{\rho}+\omega^2(r_E^2-r_0^2)-2g(z_E-z_0),\qquad Q=\frac{\pi d^2}{4}w_E.$$
$$p_{mA}=p_{m0}+\rho g(z_0-z_A)+\frac{\rho\omega^2}{2}(r_A^2-r_0^2).$$
<p><strong>Geometrija mora biti zadana:</strong> izvorna PDF skica nije priložena ovoj zbirci. Sam tekst ne određuje kote i radijus izlaza, pa raniji brojčani rezultat nije potvrđen. Istraživač ispod prikazuje jasno definiran model: $r_0=z_0=0$, $r_A=r=1\,\mathrm m$, $z_A=-H_1=-0{,}8\,\mathrm m$, dok se $r_E$ i $z_E$ zadaju zasebno. Početna kota izlaza u ovom modelu jest $L=2{,}2\,\mathrm m$; to nije rekonstrukcija nedostupne izvorne skice.</p>
</div>


### Zadatak Z100 — Sila na konvergentno koljeno (30°) {.unnumbered}

<div class="v11-problem">
<strong>100.</strong> Konvergentno koljeno koristi se za usmjeravanje vode masenog protoka 14 kg/s iz horizontalnog dijela cijevi u dio cijevi otklonjen od horizontale pod kutom 30°. Ispust se vrši u okolinu u kojoj vlada atmosferski tlak. Površina poprečnog presjeka na ulazu u koljeno iznosi 113 cm2, pri čemu površina poprečnog presjeka na izlazu iz koljena iznosi 7 cm2. Geodetska visinska razlika između ulaza i izlaza iznosi 30 cm. Masa koljena i vode može se zanemariti prilikom proračuna. Potrebno je odrediti pretlak u središnjoj točki ulaznog presjeka koljena, te silu potrebnu da bi se koljeno držalo u nepomičnom položaju. Prilikom proračuna korekcijski faktor količine gibanja iznosi βk=1,03.
</div>

<dl class="v11-data"><dt>Zadano</dt><dd>$\dot m=14\ \mathrm{kg/s}$, $\alpha=30^\circ$, $A_1=0{,}0113\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $A_2=0{,}0007\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $h=0{,}3\ \mathrm{m}$, $\beta_k=1{,}03$, $p_2=p_{atm}$, $\rho=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.</dd><dt>Odrediti</dt><dd>$p_1$ i $\vec F_R$.</dd></dl>

<svg class="v11-static" viewBox="0 0 900 330" role="img" aria-labelledby="z100-svg-title"><title id="z100-svg-title">Konvergentno koljeno s kontrolnim volumenom i silama</title><defs><marker id="z100-blue" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#1976b9"/></marker><marker id="z100-red" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#c53b3b"/></marker><marker id="z100-pressure" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#6e5bb5"/></marker></defs><path d="M90 215H380L620 95H790M90 275H380L620 135H790" fill="none" stroke="#6d8595" stroke-width="18"/><path d="M90 221H380L620 101H790M90 269H380L620 129H790" fill="none" stroke="#8dd0f3" stroke-width="10"/><path d="M65 180H805V300H65Z" fill="none" stroke="#8195a4" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="9 6"/><path d="M130 190H300" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z100-blue)"/><path d="M635 145L750 85" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z100-blue)"/><path d="M145 245H275" stroke="#6e5bb5" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z100-pressure)"/><path d="M385 265H250M385 265V170" stroke="#c53b3b" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z100-red)"/><text x="150" y="180" class="v11-svg-label">v₁</text><text x="690" y="80" class="v11-svg-label">v₂</text><text x="170" y="235" class="v11-svg-small">p₁A₁</text><text x="205" y="300" class="v11-svg-small" fill="#b11f38">Rₓ</text><text x="395" y="175" class="v11-svg-small" fill="#b11f38">R_z</text><text x="775" y="120" class="v11-svg-small">p₂,g = 0</text><text x="80" y="170" class="v11-svg-small">kontrolni volumen</text><text x="480" y="280" class="v11-svg-small">x →, z ↑</text></svg>

<div class="v11-solution">
<h4>Rješenje</h4>
<p><strong>1. Energija i kontinuitet.</strong> $Q=\dot m/\rho=0{,}014\ \mathrm{m^3/s}$, $v_1=Q/A_1=1{,}239\ \mathrm{m/s}$ i $v_2=Q/A_2=20{,}00\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Uz $p_{2,g}=0$ Bernoulli daje
$$
p_{1,g}=\rho\left[\frac{v_2^2-v_1^2}{2}+g(z_2-z_1)\right]=202{,}2\ \mathrm{kPa}.
$$</p>
<p><strong>2. Količina gibanja.</strong> Neka je $\vec R=\vec F_{wall\to fluid}$. Tlačna sila na ulazu je $+p_{1,g}A_1\hat i$, a izlazna tlačna sila je nula. Zato
$$
\vec R+p_{1,g}A_1\hat i=\beta_k\dot m(\vec v_2-\vec v_1).
$$
Slijedi $R_x=-2053\ \mathrm{N}$, $R_z=+144\ \mathrm{N}$ i $|\vec R|=2058\ \mathrm{N}$. To je sila oslonca potrebna za mirovanje koljena; sila fluida na koljeno jednaka je $-\vec R$.</p>
</div>

### Zadatak Z101 — Sila na U-koljeno (180°) {.unnumbered}

<div class="v11-problem">
<strong>101.</strong> Koljeno iz prethodnog zadatka zamijenjeno je koljenom prikazanim na slici koje sa je otklonjeno od horizontalne osi za kut od 180°. Geodetska visinska razlika između ulaznog i izlaznog središnjeg presjeka koljena iznosi 0,3 m. Potrebno je odrediti silu koja će održavati koljeno u nepomičnom položaju. Korekcijski faktor iznosi βk = 1,03.
</div>

<dl class="v11-data"><dt>Zadano</dt><dd>$\dot m=14\ \mathrm{kg/s}$, $\alpha=180^\circ$, $A_1=0{,}0113\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $A_2=0{,}0007\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $h=0{,}3\ \mathrm{m}$, $\beta_k=1{,}03$, $p_2=p_{atm}$, $\rho=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.</dd><dt>Odrediti</dt><dd>$\vec F_R$.</dd></dl>

<svg class="v11-static" viewBox="0 0 900 320" role="img" aria-labelledby="z101-svg-title"><title id="z101-svg-title">U-koljeno s ulazom udesno i izlazom ulijevo</title><defs><marker id="z101-blue" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#1976b9"/></marker><marker id="z101-red" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#c53b3b"/></marker><marker id="z101-pressure" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#6e5bb5"/></marker></defs><path d="M120 225H540Q690 225 690 115Q690 55 610 55H310M120 275H540Q740 275 740 115Q740 5 610 5H310" fill="none" stroke="#6d8595" stroke-width="18"/><path d="M120 231H540Q680 231 680 115Q680 65 610 65H310M120 269H540Q730 269 730 115Q730 15 610 15H310" fill="none" stroke="#8dd0f3" stroke-width="10"/><path d="M80 180H780V300H80Z" fill="none" stroke="#8195a4" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="9 6"/><path d="M150 205H330" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z101-blue)"/><path d="M520 40H350" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z101-blue)"/><path d="M170 250H330" stroke="#6e5bb5" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z101-pressure)"/><path d="M470 275H250" stroke="#c53b3b" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z101-red)"/><text x="170" y="195" class="v11-svg-label">v₁</text><text x="440" y="32" class="v11-svg-label">v₂</text><text x="175" y="245" class="v11-svg-small">p₁A₁</text><text x="290" y="305" class="v11-svg-small" fill="#b11f38">Rₓ</text><text x="85" y="170" class="v11-svg-small">kontrolni volumen</text><text x="275" y="92" class="v11-svg-small">p₂,g = 0</text></svg>

<div class="v11-solution">
<h4>Rješenje</h4>
<p>Brzine i ulazni tlak određuju se istim energetskim dijelom kao u Z100, jer su $A_1$, $A_2$, $h$ i izlazni atmosferski tlak isti: $v_1=1{,}239\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $v_2=20{,}00\ \mathrm{m/s}$ i $p_{1,g}=202{,}2\ \mathrm{kPa}$.</p>
<p>Za U-koljeno je $\vec v_2=-v_2\hat i$, pa je $\Delta v_x=-v_2-v_1$, a vertikalni tok količine gibanja jednak je nuli. Iz $\vec R+p_{1,g}A_1\hat i=\beta_k\dot m(\vec v_2-\vec v_1)$ slijedi $R_x=-2591\ \mathrm{N}$ i $R_z=0$. Sila oslonca je ulijevo; fluid na koljeno djeluje jednako velikom silom udesno.</p>
</div>


### Zadatak Z102 — Mlaz na ploču {.unnumbered}

<div class="v11-problem">
<strong>102.</strong> Voda istrujava iz mlaznice srednjom brzinom 20 m/s, pri čemu udara u stacionarnu vertikalno položenu ploču, maseni protok vode iznosi 10 kg/s . Nakon udara, mlaz vode se raspršuje jednoliko u svim smjerovima duž ravnine ploče. Potrebno je odrediti silu potrebnu da ploča ostane u početnom položaju.
</div>

<dl class="v11-data"><dt>Zadano</dt><dd>$v_{sr}=20\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $\dot m=10\ \mathrm{kg/s}$, $p_{atm}=101325\ \mathrm{Pa}$, $\rho=1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.</dd><dt>Odrediti</dt><dd>$\vec F_R$.</dd></dl>

<svg class="v11-static" viewBox="0 0 900 300" role="img" aria-labelledby="z102-svg-title"><title id="z102-svg-title">Mlaz koji udara okomito u ravnu ploču i raspršuje se po njenoj ravnini</title><defs><marker id="z102-blue" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#1976b9"/></marker><marker id="z102-red" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#c53b3b"/></marker></defs><path d="M80 155H470" stroke="#70c5ee" stroke-width="20"/><path d="M470 155V70M470 155V240" stroke="#70c5ee" stroke-width="14"/><path d="M490 45V265" stroke="#405b6d" stroke-width="20"/><path d="M125 120H350" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z102-blue)"/><path d="M610 155H750" stroke="#c53b3b" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z102-red)"/><text x="150" y="108" class="v11-svg-label" fill="#1976b9">v₁</text><text x="585" y="142" class="v11-svg-small" fill="#b11f38">fluid na ploču</text><text x="505" y="65" class="v11-svg-small">izlazi po ravnini ploče</text><text x="120" y="190" class="v11-svg-small">kontrolni volumen oko udara</text></svg>

<div class="v11-solution">
<h4>Rješenje</h4>
<p>Ulazni tok količine gibanja u normalnom smjeru iznosi $\dot mv$. Nakon udara voda ne mora stati: ona teče po ravnini ploče. Međutim, zbog simetričnog raspršivanja ukupna izlazna normalna komponenta zadovoljava $\sum\dot mv_{out,x}=0$.</p>
<p>Stoga je $F_{plate\to fluid,x}=-\dot mv=-200\ \mathrm{N}$, a sila fluida na ploču ima magnitudu $F_{fluid\to plate}=200\ \mathrm{N}$ udesno. Da ploča ostane nepomična, oslonac mora na nju djelovati silom $200\ \mathrm{N}$ ulijevo.</p>
</div>


## Vjetroturbina: količina gibanja i snaga

Rotor usporava zrak pa prima silu; istodobno iz struje preuzima mehaničku snagu. U idealnom modelu diska vrijedi $v_d=v_1(1-a)$, $v_2=v_1(1-2a)$, $F=\rho A v_d(v_1-v_2)$ i $P=Fv_d$. Pri istom faktoru indukcije $a$ sila raste s kvadratom, a snaga s kubom uzvodne brzine. U sljedećem prikazu $a$ je određen iz izvornog slučaja Z103 i ostaje isti pri usporedbi.

<section class="v11x-shell v11x-task" id="v11-z103-lab" data-widget-role="application" aria-labelledby="v11-z103-title">
<header class="v11x-head"><h4 id="v11-z103-title">Vjetroturbina: zašto snaga raste s kubom brzine?</h4><p>Idealni disk usporava struju: brzina kroz rotor manja je od uzvodne brzine. Snaga pretvorbe uzima se bez mehaničkih i električnih gubitaka. Marker na grafu pokazuje trenutačnu raspoloživu snagu vjetra.</p></header>

fill="#edf6fb" stroke="#405b6d" stroke-width="6"/><path d="M420 58V282M360 170H480" stroke="#405b6d" stroke-width="6"/><path id="v11-z103-out" class="v11x-flow" d="M485 170H640" fill="none" id="v11-z103-v1label" x="145" y="140" class="v11x-svg-label v11x-svg-flow">v₁</text><text id="v11-z103-v2label" x="540" y="145" class="v11x-svg-label v11x-svg-flow">v₂</text><text id="v11-z103-dlabel" x="365" y="35" class="v11x-svg-small">rotor, D</text><text x="275" y="335" class="v11x-svg-small v11x-svg-force">potisak zraka na stup</text><path d="M705 320H950M705 55V320" stroke="#8195a4" stroke-width="3"/><path id="v11-z103-curve" d="M705 320L950 55" fill="none" stroke="#1976b9" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M705 170H950" stroke="#d5e2ea" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 6"/><circle id="v11-z103-marker" cx="800" cy="220" r="8" fill="#c53b3b"/><text x="695" y="42" class="v11x-svg-small">P<sub>wind</sub></text><text x="930" y="348" class="v11x-svg-small">v</text><text x="750" <div class="v11x-controls"><div class="v11x-control"><label for="v11-z103-v">Brzina vjetra v₁ <output id="v11-z103-v-out"></output></label><input id="v11-z103-v" type="range" min="1.5" max="8" step="0.01" value="3.13"></div><div class="v11x-control"><label for="v11-z103-D">Promjer rotora D <output id="v11-z103-D-out"></output></label><input id="v11-z103-D" type="range" min="5" max="20" step="0.1" value="10"></div></div>

<div class="v11x-explain"><h5>Zašto se rezultat promijenio?</h5><p id="v11-z103-why"></p></div>
<div class="v11x-chain"><div><strong>Presjek rotora</strong><span id="v11-z103-chain-a"></span></div><div><strong>Tok zraka</strong><span id="v11-z103-chain-m"></span></div><div><strong>Snaga</strong><span id="v11-z103-chain-p"></span></div><div><strong>Momentum</strong><span id="v11-z103-chain-f"></span></div></div>
</section>

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("v11-z103-lab");
  if (!root) return;
  const v = root.querySelector("#v11-z103-v"),
    D = root.querySelector("#v11-z103-D"),
    base = root.querySelector("#v11-z103-base"),
    double = root.querySelector("#v11-z103-double"),
    fmt = (n, k = 2) => n.toLocaleString("hr-HR", { minimumFractionDigits: k, maximumFractionDigits: k });
  let state,
    previousState,
    lastChanged = "initial";
  const rho = 1.2,
    baseV = 3.13,
    baseD = 10,
    baseA = (Math.PI * baseD * baseD) / 4,
    eta = 400 / (0.5 * rho * baseA * baseV * baseV * baseV);
  function compute() {
    const vi = +v.value,
      dia = +D.value,
      A = (Math.PI * dia * dia) / 4,
      pwind = 0.5 * rho * A * vi * vi * vi,
      p = eta * pwind,
      disk = MF1.actuatorDisk(rho,A,vi,eta),
      mdot = disk.mass, v2=disk.wake, F=disk.force;
    return { vi, dia, A, pwind, p, mdot, v2, F, eta, vd:disk.disk };
  }
  function draw(s){
 const svg=root.querySelector('.v11x-scene svg'),r=s.dia*5,ru=r*Math.sqrt(s.vd/s.vi),rw=r*Math.sqrt(s.vd/s.v2),fs=130/Math.max(s.F,600),vs=20;
 let curve='';const pmax=.5*rho*s.A*8**3*1.12;for(let i=0;i<=64;i++){const v=i/8;curve+=(i?'L':'M')+(705+245*v/8)+' '+(320-250*.5*rho*s.A*v**3/pmax);}
 svg.innerHTML='<title>Idealni disk: očuvanje mase i snaga vjetra</title>'+
 '<path d="M70 '+(170-ru)+'Q260 '+(170-ru)+' 370 '+(170-r)+'Q510 '+(170-rw)+' 645 '+(170-rw)+'L645 '+(170+rw)+'Q510 '+(170+rw)+' 370 '+(170+r)+'Q260 '+(170+ru)+' 70 '+(170+ru)+'Z" fill="#e0f2fe" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>'+
 '<ellipse cx="370" cy="170" rx="14" ry="'+r+'" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="3"/>'+MF1.svgArrow(90,170,s.vi*vs,0,'#0284c7','v₁')+MF1.svgArrow(460,170,s.v2*vs,0,'#0284c7','v₂')+
 MF1.svgArrow(370,310,s.F*fs,0,'#dc2626','F')+MF1.svgArrow(370,348,-s.F*fs,0,'#7c3aed','reakcija oslonca')+
 '<text x="75" y="35">D='+fmt(s.dia,1)+' m; v diska='+fmt(s.vd,2)+' m/s</text><text x="75" y="375">ṁ = ρA v diska; P = F v diska; Cₚ = '+fmt(s.eta,4)+'</text>'+
 '<path d="M705 55V320H950" fill="none" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="2"/><path d="'+curve+'" fill="none" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="3"/>'+
 '<circle cx="'+(705+245*s.vi/8)+'" cy="'+(320-250*s.pwind/pmax)+'" r="6" fill="#dc2626"/><text x="710" y="40">P vjetra [kW]</text><text x="880" y="350">v [m/s]</text><text x="697" y="340">0</text><text x="945" y="340">8</text><text x="690" y="65">'+fmt(pmax/1000,1)+'</text>';
 MF1.separateScene(svg,'path[d="M705 55V320H950"]','40 10 625 385','665 15 320 355','Snaga vjetra raste s trećom potencijom uzvodne brzine');
 MF1.renderPlot(svg.mf1Detail,{x:[0,8],y:[0,pmax/1000],title:'Raspoloživa i izdvojena snaga',xlabel:'uzvodna brzina v₁ [m/s]',ylabel:'snaga P [kW]',curves:[{fn:v=>.5*rho*s.A*v**3/1000},{fn:v=>s.eta*.5*rho*s.A*v**3/1000,color:'#168361',dash:'6 4'}],points:[{x:s.vi,y:s.pwind/1000},{x:s.vi,y:s.p/1000,color:'#168361'}],note:'Plavo: ½ρAv₁³ · zeleno: Cₚ · ½ρAv₁³ · Cₚ = '+fmt(s.eta,4)});
}
  function why(s) {
    if (!previousState || lastChanged === "initial")
      return "Snaga vjetra sadrži dva učinka: kinetička energija svakog kilograma zraka raste s v², a kroz rotor u sekundi prolazi masa proporcionalna v. Zato P₍wind₎ raste s v³; pri dvostrukoj brzini raste osam puta.";
    if (lastChanged === "v")
      return (
        "Brzina vjetra je " +
        (s.vi > previousState.vi ? "povećana" : "smanjena") +
        " s " +
        fmt(previousState.vi, 2) +
        " na " +
        fmt(s.vi, 2) +
        " m/s. Kinetička energija po kilogramu mijenja se s v², a maseni tok zraka s v, pa je P₍wind₎ sada " +
        fmt(s.pwind / 1000, 3) +
        " kW i prati kub brzine. Potisak prati promjenu momentuma i ovdje raste s v²."
      );
    return (
      "Promjer rotora je " +
      (s.dia > previousState.dia ? "povećan" : "smanjen") +
      " s " +
      fmt(previousState.dia, 1) +
      " na " +
      fmt(s.dia, 1) +
      " m. Površina presjeka mijenja se s D², pa kroz rotor prolazi proporcionalno više zraka; pri istoj brzini rastu P₍wind₎ i potisak u istom omjeru kao A."
    );
  }
  function sync(s) {
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-v-out").value = fmt(s.vi, 2) + " m/s";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-D-out").value = fmt(s.dia, 1) + " m";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-F").value = fmt(s.F, 0) + " N →";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-eta").value = fmt(100 * s.eta, 2) + " %";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-pwind").value = fmt(s.pwind / 1000, 3) + " kW";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-p").value = fmt(s.p / 1000, 3) + " kW";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-why").textContent = why(s);
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-chain-a").textContent = "A = " + fmt(s.A, 2) + " m²";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-chain-m").textContent = "ṁ = " + fmt(s.mdot, 1) + " kg/s";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-chain-p").textContent = "P₍wind₎ = " + fmt(s.pwind / 1000, 3) + " kW";
    root.querySelector("#v11-z103-chain-f").textContent = "F = " + fmt(s.F, 0) + " N";
  }
  function update() {
    state = compute();
    sync(state);
    draw(state);
  }
  function setSource(speed) {
    previousState = state ? { ...state } : null;
    lastChanged = "initial";
    v.value = speed;
    D.value = 10;
    base.classList.toggle("is-active", speed === baseV);
    double.classList.toggle("is-active", speed !== baseV);
    update();
  }
  base.addEventListener("click", () => setSource(baseV));
  double.addEventListener("click", () => setSource(2 * baseV));
  [
    [v, "v"],
    [D, "D"],
  ].forEach(([el, key]) =>
    el.addEventListener("input", () => {
      previousState = state ? { ...state } : null;
      lastChanged = key;
      base.classList.remove("is-active");
      double.classList.remove("is-active");
      update();
    }),
  );
  update();
})();
</script>

### Zadatak Z103 — Vjetroturbina {.unnumbered}

<div class="v11-problem">
<strong>103.</strong> Vjetroturbina promjera 10m generira snagu od 0,4 kW pri brzini nastrujavanja vjetra na vjetroturbinu od 3,13 m/s . Potrebno je odrediti učinkovitost vjetroturbine i horizontalnu silu vjetra na potporni stup vjetroturbine za dotičnu i dvostruko veću brzinu vjetra. Pretpostaviti jednak stupanj učinkovitosti u oba slučaja. Gustoća zraka iznosi 1,2 kg/m3 , pretpostaviti da je zrak idealan fluid.
</div>

<dl class="v11-data"><dt>Zadano</dt><dd>$d=10\ \mathrm{m}$, $P=400\ \mathrm{W}$, $v_1=3{,}13\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $2v_1=6{,}26\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $p_{atm}=101325\ \mathrm{Pa}$, $\rho_z=1{,}2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.</dd><dt>Odrediti</dt><dd>$\eta$ i $\vec F_R$.</dd></dl>

<svg class="v11-static" viewBox="0 0 900 310" role="img" aria-labelledby="z103-svg-title"><title id="z103-svg-title">Kontrolni volumen zraka kroz rotor vjetroturbine</title><defs><marker id="z103-blue" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#1976b9"/></marker><marker id="z103-red" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L8 4L0 8Z" fill="#c53b3b"/></marker></defs><path d="M80 65Q270 120 400 95Q570 75 830 40M80 245Q270 190 400 215Q570 235 830 270" fill="none" stroke="#8195a4" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="9 6"/><path d="M85 155H355" stroke="#70c5ee" stroke-width="18" marker-end="url(#z103-blue)"/><ellipse cx="430" cy="155" rx="26" ry="105" fill="#edf6fb" stroke="#405b6d" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M430 55V255M375 155H485" stroke="#405b6d" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M500 155H790" stroke="#9ed8f3" stroke-width="12" marker-end="url(#z103-blue)"/><path d="M290 280H440" stroke="#c53b3b" stroke-width="5" marker-end="url(#z103-red)"/><text x="155" y="135" class="v11-svg-label" fill="#1976b9">v₁</text><text x="665" y="135" class="v11-svg-label" fill="#1976b9">v₂</text><text x="390" y="38" class="v11-svg-small">rotor, D</text><text x="245" y="300" class="v11-svg-small" fill="#b11f38">potisak na stup</text><text x="85" y="45" class="v11-svg-small">kontrolni volumen zraka</text></svg>

<div class="v11-solution">
<h4>Rješenje</h4>
<p>Površina rotora je $A=\pi D^2/4=78{,}54\ \mathrm{m^2}$, a raspoloživa snaga vjetra $P_{wind}=\rho Av_1^3/2=1{,}445\ \mathrm{kW}$. Učinkovitost je zato $\eta=P/P_{wind}=0{,}2768$, odnosno $27{,}68\%$.</p>
<p>Za idealni rotor rabi se teorija diska. Pretpostavljamo da zadana korisna snaga odgovara mehaničkoj snazi rotora, odnosno da su gubici pretvorbe zanemareni: $C_P=\eta$. Vrijedi $C_P=4a(1-a)^2$, pri čemu biramo granu $0\le a\le1/3$. Brzina kroz disk je $v_d=v_1(1-a)$, u dalekom tragu $v_2=v_1(1-2a)$, a stvarni maseni protok $\dot m=\rho A v_d$. Zato je $F=\dot m(v_1-v_2)=P/v_d$. Dobiva se $a=0{,}08214$, $v_d=2{,}873\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $v_2=2{,}616\ \mathrm{m/s}$ i $F=139{,}2\ \mathrm N$. Pri dvostrukoj brzini snaga je $3{,}2\ \mathrm{kW}$, a sila $556{,}9\ \mathrm N$. Ako zadana učinkovitost uključuje nepoznate gubitke generatora, sila se bez dodatnih podataka ne može jednoznačno odrediti.</p>
</div>

## Kako rješavati zadatak količine gibanja?

1. Odaberite kontrolni volumen i definirajte osi.
2. Odredite protoke, brzine i njihove komponente.
3. Izračunajte tlakove ako nisu poznati iz druge bilance, često iz Bernoullijeve jednadžbe.
4. Nacrtajte sve vanjske sile na fluid: tlačne sile, reakciju stijenke, težinu i eventualne druge sile.
5. Primijenite
$$
\sum F_x=\sum_{iz}\beta\dot mv_x-\sum_{ul}\beta\dot mv_x,
\qquad
\sum F_z=\sum_{iz}\beta\dot mv_z-\sum_{ul}\beta\dot mv_z.
$$
6. Tek na kraju primijenite akciju i reakciju ako se traži sila fluida na cijev ili ploču.
